entry.summary: Measures how much referential information gestures carry on their own and in combination with speech in a video-mediated referential communication game, varying whether partners can see each other. Finds skeletal gesture representations alone predict the intended referent and that multimodal fusion helps most when the transcript-based model is uncertain.

entry.title: Rethinking 3D Segmentation from Individual LiDAR Scans: Incidence-Aware Sampling on the SIP Benchmark

author.name: Seongyong Kim, Jingdao Chen, Yong Kwon Cho

entry.summary: The paper studies 3D semantic segmentation from single LiDAR scans on construction sites, where coverage is partial and point density varies with acquisition geometry. It proposes incidence-aware sampling to allocate a fixed point budget more effectively between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements.

entry.title: SUMI: Scalable Unified Model for 3D Point Cloud Inference

author.name: Yanlong LI, Kanchana Thilakarathna

entry.summary: SUMI refines coarse-to-fine point cloud completion by injecting noisy geometric features into cross-attention with coarse structural features, so diffusion denoising acts as a refinement operator rather than a standalone generator. This targets weak local detail recovery in the fine stage.

entry.title: FreCast: Refining Radar Echo Intensity via Phase-Preserving Amplitude Residual Diffusion for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Heping Fang, Zihuai Yin, Kaicheng Mao, Peiguang Zhang, Peng Yang

entry.summary: Targets a known weakness of deep precipitation nowcasting: models get the spatial structure of future radar echoes roughly right but the intensity values wrong. FreCast keeps the predicted phase structure fixed and applies a diffusion model only to the amplitude residual, refining echo intensity rather than regenerating whole sequences.

entry.title: RayLift: Lifting Complementary Ray-Wise Evidence with 3D Geometry Priors for Semantic Scene Completion

author.name: Meng Wang, Hongxia Yu, Wenzhe He, Xingdong Song, Huilong Pi, Jiapeng Zhang, Ruihui Li

entry.summary: For camera-based 3D semantic scene completion, RayLift stops treating stereo depth as a hard geometric constraint and instead lifts complementary per-ray evidence combined with priors from a frozen 3D vision foundation model. This is meant to stop depth errors from propagating into the voxel grid.

entry.title: FiRe: Fixed-Noise Refinement for Visual Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: Yan Zeng, Changlu Guo, Oskar Kristoffersen, Anders Nymark Christensen, Morten Rieger Hannemose, Anders Bjorholm Dahl

entry.summary: Generates visual counterfactual explanations without traversing a long reverse diffusion trajectory, instead performing refinement at a fixed noise level so that the classifier always sees clean-like images and spatial control is easier to maintain. This removes the need for costly recursive denoising or low-quality single-step estimates.

entry.title: MRI super-resolution in ten sampling steps using a diffusion bridge model

author.name: Mojtaba Safari, Hang Yu, Zach Eidex, Mingzhe Hu, Ryan J. Sanford, Alexandru Florea, Shansong Wang, Chih-Wei Chang, Erik H Middlebrooks, Aditya Juloori, Stanley L. Liauw, Ralph Weichselbaum, Xiaofeng Yang

entry.summary: Formulates MRI super-resolution as a diffusion bridge that transports directly between low- and high-resolution image distributions instead of starting from Gaussian noise, allowing high-quality reconstruction in about ten sampling steps. The construction uses a Doob h-transform of the underlying stochastic process.

entry.title: In-Loop Model Adaptation with Coupled Latent-Noise Guidance for High-Fidelity Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Yushun Tang, Weiming Chen, Siyi Liu, Yi Zhang, Feng Wu, Zhihai He

entry.summary: Proposes adapting a text-to-image diffusion model to a reference subject during the generation loop itself, using coupled latent and noise guidance, instead of requiring large domain-specific training or hundreds of pre-generation fine-tuning steps. The goal is fast, high-fidelity subject identity preservation across varied prompts.

entry.title: Diffusion Image Editing via Asynchronous Token Decoding

author.name: Yang Shi, Liangsi Lu, Minzhe Guo, Yifeng Xie, Yanhui Chen, Jingchao Wang, Xuhang Chen

entry.summary: Observes that switching the text condition mid-sampling in diffusion editing causes global drift because denoising couples all tokens, and proposes decoding tokens asynchronously with token-indexed condition switching and differentiated update policies. Editable locations are estimated from token-wise signals so unedited regions stay stable.

entry.title: ControlRadio: Prompt-Driven Controllable Diffusion for Cross-Modal Radio Map Generation

author.name: Kangjun Liu, Xiying Pan, Shuhang Zhang, Xiang Xiang, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang

entry.summary: ControlRadio is a controllable diffusion framework that synthesizes wireless radio propagation maps from natural-language prompts plus environmental layouts such as buildings and transmitter positions. It aims to replace dense measurements or expensive physical simulation for network planning and sensing.

entry.title: SwissCrop25: A National Multi-Year Benchmark for Operational Crop Mapping

author.name: Thomas Lauber, Mehmet Ozgur Turkoglu, S\'el\`ene Ledain, Helge Aasen

entry.summary: SwissCrop25 is a national multi-year crop mapping benchmark combining Sentinel-2 time series, daily temperature, a 73-class crop taxonomy and five non-crop classes across seven growing seasons, with a leave-one-year-out evaluation protocol. It is designed to test year-to-year generalization and joint cropland delineation with fine-grained classification together rather than in isolation.

entry.title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows

author.name: Jonas Leo Mueller, Sebastian Hoefler, Dario Zanca, Naga Venkata Sai Jitin Jami, Thomas Altstidl, Bjoern M. Eskofier

entry.summary: MH-NFPG estimates human pose from sparse millimeter-wave radar point clouds using a conditional normalizing flow over a spatiotemporal transformer backbone, producing multiple hypotheses and calibrated uncertainty in a single pass. It contrasts with deterministic radar pose methods and slow diffusion-based multi-hypothesis alternatives.

entry.title: Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment for Embodied Control

author.name: Hwanhee Kim, Jaehyun Jang, Seungmin Cha, Hyeonseo Yun, Donghoon Lee, Chang D. Yoo

entry.summary: ALVA evaluates whether an embodied agent has completed a natural-language instruction by conditioning a pretrained vision-language model on observations, the executed action sequence and the instruction, first summarizing action-conditioned visual transitions then judging the trajectory. It argues final-frame or embedding-similarity checks miss necessary intermediate transitions.

entry.title: Diversity Matters: Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection for Data-Efficient Backdoor Attacks

author.name: Yi Yang, Xiaoke Chen, Jinyang Huang, Feng-Qi Cui, Yu-Tong Guo, Jia-Cheng Zhao, Haiming Jin, Xiaokang Zhou, Meng Li

entry.summary: DFCS improves data-efficient backdoor attacks by clustering pretrained features and selecting one representative sample per region, so that poisoned samples cover diverse feature space rather than clustering redundantly in similar semantic regions. It is training-free and trigger-agnostic, with a first-order analysis motivating the allocation.

entry.title: A Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering

author.name: Louis De Oliveira, Anastasia Karpova, Georges Nader, Antoine Houdard, Pierre Mezieres, Damien Rioux-Lavoie, Romain Pacanowski

entry.summary: This paper proposes a hybrid model that keeps an analytic microfacet BRDF core and adds a compact neural correction to reproduce effects like diffraction, iridescence and layering that standard models miss, while staying fast enough for real-time rendering. It targets the size and cost problems of purely neural BRDF representations.

entry.title: Projection-Retraction MPPI: Exact Constraint-Manifold Control for Manipulators

author.name: Seulchan Lee, Leesai Park, Minhyeong Kang, Sanghyun Kim

entry.summary: PR-MPPI enforces hard constraints inside the sampled dynamics of Model Predictive Path Integral control by projecting and retracting sampled velocities onto the constraint manifold, rather than penalizing violations in the cost. This exactly maintains closed kinematic chains, joint limits and clearances that soft penalties only approximate.

entry.title: Entanglement-Free Trajectory Planning for Tethered Mobile Robots with a Slack Tether

author.name: Gianpietro Battocletti, Dimitris Boskos, Bart De Schutter

entry.summary: Presents a motion planner for tethered mobile robots with slack cables that explicitly reasons about entanglement, accounting for tether dynamics and exogenous forces rather than assuming the cable shape is determined solely by obstacles. It computes trajectories that provably avoid entangled configurations.

entry.title: DAP-Pose: Deep Temporal Alignment and Physics-aware Cross-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Pose Estimation

author.name: Jianhan Lin, Yuchu Qin, Jiateng Yuan, Wenbo Zhang, Shuai Gao

entry.summary: DAP-Pose is an end-to-end multimodal pose estimator that fuses visual, inertial, and GNSS cues through a bi-level cross-modal module, aligns asynchronous streams in latent space to tolerate temporal offsets without hardware synchronization, and adds manifold and GNSS-based physical constraints. The target is robust localization for vehicles and mobile robots in complex environments.

entry.title: Contraction Analysis of Holomorphic Dynamical Systems via the Intrinsic Kobayashi Metric

author.name: Soumic Sarkar

entry.summary: Analyzes incremental stability of holomorphic dynamical systems using the intrinsic Kobayashi pseudometric, formalizing contraction as a Dini-derivative inequality along trajectories and deriving exponential distance contraction via Finsler-metric arguments. It also supplies a practical route to verifying the otherwise hard-to-check intrinsic condition.

entry.title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair

author.name: Prajwal S. Venkateshmurthy

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark for LLM repair of broken document sources across LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown, built from an empirically mined taxonomy of real compilation faults rather than ad-hoc synthetic edits. The taxonomy is instantiated as dozens of AST-aware mutation operators across three formats.

entry.title: Legal Responsibilities Using Autonomous Agents For Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Mark Burgess

entry.summary: Uses Promise Theory and a downstream principle of causal influence to argue about how legal responsibility should be allocated when autonomous AI agents cause criminal or negligent damage. It suggests responsibility can be extended to agents where tracing is impractical, with agent freedoms limited by policy.

entry.title: Deep probabilistic logic programming for diagnostic reasoning from incomplete information: A case study in stroke detection

author.name: Felix Weitk\"amper, Monchito Avila, Elizabeth Nanjala, Siska, Grace Zawadi

entry.summary: A neuro-symbolic case study using probabilistic logic programming to combine literature-derived summary statistics with neural analysis of patient images for stroke detection, avoiding the need for privacy-sensitive raw datasets. The pipeline shows how published aggregate evidence can be encoded into a transparent probabilistic program with learned perceptual components. Interesting for privacy-constrained clinical modeling.

entry.title: Harnessing Abundance: A Generativity Perspective on Human-GenAI Collaboration

author.name: Yoram M Kalman, Yun Wan

entry.summary: A conceptual paper arguing that conflicting findings on generative AI and creativity stem from abundance, and proposing generative fit as the mechanism determining when abundance helps or harms. Draws on Generativity Theory to reconcile results on creativity gains versus reduced collective diversity.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Task Federated Learning in VANETs

author.name: M. Saeid HaghighiFard, Sinem Coleri

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-task federated learning framework for vehicular networks in which vehicles run different learning tasks under non-IID data, intermittent connectivity and high mobility, using autoencoder-based reliability weighting for clustering and aggregation. Targets practical collaborative learning in car fleets.

entry.title: Exact Zarankiewicz Values On Two Finite Frontier Slices

author.name: Koyar Afrasyab

entry.summary: Provides a certificate-based computer-assisted proof establishing exact values for several Zarankiewicz numbers on small bipartite frontier slices, with orbit certificates ruling out matrices at the next edge count. Also corrects a neighbouring published entry and reports one cell only as bounds.

entry.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling

author.name: Renjie Zhao, Yuxiang Wu, Mingyu Zhang, Jiaxin Li, Sisi Li, Yimin Sheng, Tianxi Tan, Zhenkai Zhang, Jianyi Zhu, Yong-Lu Li

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D medical segmentation network whose blocks split attention heads between local windows and global sparse attention while adding grouped hierarchical channel modelling, aiming to reconcile long-range anatomical context with sharp boundaries. Targets semantic mismatch and redundancy in existing encoder-decoder designs.

entry.title: Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction

author.name: Jingxian Xu, Yuhao Huang, Rusi Chen, Yanfeng Zhou, Dong Ni

entry.summary: PPOC-LL performs medical landmark localization with prototype learning and progressive offset correction, aiming to match multi-stage refinement accuracy at much lower parameter and compute cost. Combines multi-scale patch-level feature pyramids with coarse-to-fine offset refinement.

entry.title: AkasicDB: Demonstrating Omni RAG with a Unified Vector-Graph-Relational DBMS

author.name: Geonho Lee, Jeongho Park, Donghyoung Han, Min-Soo Kim

entry.summary: AkasicDB is a demo database that natively executes vector similarity search, graph traversal, and relational filtering in one engine to support complex RAG workflows without external pipelines. It extends the authors' prior Chimera system with native vector support.

entry.title: Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration

author.name: Vladyslava Spitkovska, Dmytro Kuzmenko

entry.summary: Studies how to collect data for calibrating digital twins by jointly choosing excitation-oriented trajectories via reinforcement learning and deciding when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. On a pendulum testbed a GRU estimator trained on excitation trajectories recovers physical parameters far better than task-oriented data with a random forest baseline.

entry.title: Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm

author.name: Hirofumi Suzuki

entry.summary: Introduces a backward compatibility loss for decision trees so that model updates do not needlessly change the tree-structured explanations users have already seen, and modifies CART to optimize it. Motivated by risk-sensitive settings where unstable explanations damage trust.

entry.title: Loss-Resilient Wireless Video Token Communication over Block Fading Channels

author.name: Bingyan Xie, Yongjeong Oh, Zihan Chen, Jihong Park, Yongpeng Wu, Wenjun Zhang

entry.summary: A wireless video token communication scheme prioritizes and interleaves discrete video tokens by importance, treating structural I-tokens as anchors and scoring P-tokens by temporal novelty. Shuffled mixed packetization spreads correlated tokens so block fading does not wipe out an entire structural region.

entry.title: Targeted Label-Flipping and Oversampling Attacks on Federated Conditional GANs

author.name: Panav Shah, Avishek Ghosh

entry.summary: Analyzes label-flipping poisoning in federated conditional GANs, where malicious clients remap a target class so the global generator produces the wrong content for that condition, plus an oversampling variant that upweights poisoned samples. Combines theoretical characterization with empirical measurement of attack effectiveness.

entry.title: MaxModShift: Model Privacy via Designed Shifts

author.name: Nomaan A. Kherani, Urbashi Mitra

entry.summary: Frames eavesdropping on a federated model as an estimation problem and designs deliberate model shifts that drive the eavesdropper's Fisher information matrix toward singularity, making the model unlearnable. Reports better privacy than a prior shift scheme and noise injection while using less transmit power and secret-channel bandwidth.

entry.title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection

author.name: Yidan Shen, Yu Wen, Chen Zhang, Xin Fu, Renjie Hu

entry.summary: MVMD detects mirrors using multiple views rather than single images, exploiting cross-view geometric inconsistency that mirrors create, and introduces the first multi-view mirror detection dataset. The goal is to avoid corrupted 3D reconstructions caused by reflective surfaces.

entry.title: Beyond Isotropic Assumptions: Continuity-Constrained Segmentation and GPU Morphometry for Nanoscale GBM Analysis

author.name: Arash Fatehi, Robin Ebbestad, Linus Butt, Hans Blom, Sigrid Lundberg, Hannes Olauson, Hjalmar Brismar, David Unnersj\"o-Jess, Thomas Benzing, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Presents a GPU-accelerated segmentation and morphometry pipeline for highly anisotropic 3D confocal microscopy of kidney glomerular basement membrane. Training on native acquisition volumes with random patch rotation supplies missing axial continuity without the prohibitive annotation cost of isotropic upsampling.

entry.title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning

author.name: Yousef Abdi, Mohammad Asadpour, Yousef Seyfari

entry.summary: MAGIC targets exemplar-free semi-supervised class-incremental learning, where both feature drift and degrading pseudo-labels cause forgetting. It calibrates class means and covariances via graph-based label propagation on the plastic feature space anchored to a frozen backbone.

entry.title: Readout-Rank Laws for Isotropic Quantum Tangents

author.name: Marwan Ait Haddou

entry.summary: Studies the gap between how sensitive a quantum circuit state is to parameter changes and how much of that sensitivity a fixed diagonal measurement can actually observe. Under Haar-random assumptions it proves the successive information fractions are independent Beta variables, implying severe readout-limited trainability shrinking with readout dimension.

entry.title: A cylindrical neural approximation theorem for conditional laws of McKean-Vlasov equations with common noise

author.name: Nacira Agram, Reda Hmioui, Jan Rems

entry.summary: Develops conditional cylindrical neural networks that approximate functionals of conditional laws for McKean-Vlasov equations with common noise, mapping Fourier moments and path signatures to a Gaussian mixture representation of the conditional measure. Rough-path stability plus Fourier separation yields universal approximation guarantees.

entry.title: Finite basis physics-informed neural networks with hard constraints for viscous fluid flow in highly perforated domains

author.name: Jeeeun Lee, Denis Korolev, Miro Duhovic, Seong Su Kim

entry.summary: Applies finite-basis physics-informed neural networks with hard-imposed boundary conditions to Stokes flow in domains with many perforations. Replacing penalty-based soft constraints avoids gradient conflicts and loss stiffness that degrade accuracy as perforation count grows.

entry.title: End-to-End Neural Decomposition with Koopman Operators for Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: De-Yan Lu, Xugang Lu, Yu Tsao, Jian-Jiun Ding

entry.summary: NDKoop is an end-to-end forecasting architecture that couples learned signal decomposition with a frequency-varying extension of Koopman operator modeling for non-stationary time series. The aim is to relax the time-invariance assumption that limits standard Koopman approaches.

entry.title: What Would Fix This RAG Failure? Auditing Counterfactual Response with Paired Evidence Interventions

author.name: Wenzhang Du

entry.summary: Pair-ID audits retrieval-augmented generation failures counterfactually by holding query, retrieval state, and reader fixed while crossing two evidence interventions: adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport. Over a prespecified sample of about 1,200 failures, adding support repaired roughly a third of joint cases while deletion repaired a much smaller share.

entry.title: Closing the loop in learning with missing data

author.name: Dimitrios Pylorof, Humberto E. Garcia

entry.summary: Recasts training with missing data as a control problem in which missingness is a structured loss of actuation that limits controllability of parameter error dynamics. From this view the authors derive Lyapunov-stable adaptation rules that throttle updates to preserve learning coherence under intermittent observability, with input-to-state-stability style residual bounds.

entry.title: CPDA: Class-Conditional Path Distribution Alignment for Unsupervised Time-Series Domain Adaptation

author.name: Felix Ott, Christopher Mutschler

entry.summary: Proposes a non-adversarial domain adaptation method for time series that aligns class-conditional latent path distributions rather than only global feature marginals, using a composite signature-spectral kernel. Targets the common sensor and user shift problem in wearable and device-based classification.

entry.title: Disentangling Co-Occurring Retinal Pathologies with Saliency-Guided Sparse Expert Routing

author.name: Nagur Shareef Shaik, Jeongwoo Park, Yeong-Jin Kim, Jaeuk Jung, Hyunjung Oh, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: Proposes a retinal image classifier combining guided spatial attention with a sparsely routed mixture-of-experts over feature tokens, so that computation is conditioned on the image rather than uniform. Reports that expert allocation is significantly disease-dependent, giving an interpretable decomposition of co-occurring pathologies.

entry.title: DoRF++: Spherical Representation Learning over Doppler Radiance Fields for Robust Wi-Fi Sensing

author.name: Navid Hasanzadeh, Shahrokh Valaee

entry.summary: Extends the neural-radiance-field idea to Wi-Fi channel state information by learning a spherical Doppler radiance field representation for device-free human activity and gesture recognition. The aim is robust cross-user, cross-environment generalization for upcoming WLAN sensing standards.

entry.title: Learning Deep Modality-Shared Self-Expressiveness for Image Clustering with Textual Information

author.name: Xianghan Meng, Wei He, Zhiyuan Huang, Chun-Guang Li

entry.summary: Argues that current text-assisted image clustering methods over-enforce cross-modal similarity from vision-language models and thereby distort modality-specific structure. The proposed approach learns a shared self-expressive representation that models within-modality subspace structure before aligning modalities.

entry.title: InstructionCrafter: Generating Consistent and High-Fidelity Visual Instructions

author.name: Shun Okamoto, Satoshi Iizuka, Kazuhiro Fukui

entry.summary: Tackles generation of step-by-step visual instruction sequences that must simultaneously be faithful to each text step, consistent across images, and individually high quality. The method separates temporal/instructional alignment training from per-frame quality via spatial-freeze training and instruction-aware conditioning.

entry.title: JSGS: JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views

author.name: Jinhua Cui, Anhong Wang, Kai Hu, Donghan Bu, Peihao Li, Tammam Tillo, Hao Jing, Shiao Xu

entry.summary: Compresses intermediate vision transformer token features for distributed deployment of large vision models by exploiting the two-dimensional patch-grid structure that prior codecs destroy when flattening tokens into a pseudo image. A dual-path codec handles global tokens and patch tokens separately with dedicated entropy models.

entry.title: Semi-Dense Matching Uncertainty Is Not Just Local Confidence

author.name: Khoa Hoang, Hoang-Tuan Nguyen, Huong Ninh, Hai Tran, Long Q. Tran

entry.summary: Argues that uncertainty in coarse-to-fine feature matching is not just local refinement noise: catastrophic coarse-assignment failures create heavy tails that current confidence scores ignore. The authors fit a nine-parameter calibrated Laplace mixture post hoc to capture both regimes for downstream geometric estimation.

entry.title: Toward Mask Annotation-Free Surgical Instrument Segmentation from Endoscopic Images Using Text-Prompted Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)

author.name: Nakul Poudel, Richard Simon, Cristian A. Linte

entry.summary: Builds an annotation-free surgical instrument segmentation pipeline by first using a generic text prompt with a promptable segmentation foundation model to obtain coarse binary tool masks, then refining to instance-level results without ground-truth masks or manual clicks. It works around the large domain gap that prevents direct instrument-name prompting.

entry.title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Tianchen Deng, Chongdi Wang, Nailin Wang, Lei Zhao, Ziqi Ma, Tianjun Zhang, Zhe Liu, Danwei Wang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Scales implicit neural SLAM to large environments through dynamically allocated submaps that avoid catastrophic forgetting and memory blowup, optical-flow-assisted tracking for aggressive motion, and a two-tier local-to-global loop closure for trajectory consistency. It targets the gap between small-room neural SLAM demos and real-scale mapping.

entry.title: OGG-FR: Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Yongsong Huang, Qingzhong Wang, Xiaofeng Liu, Tomo Miyazaki, Yaohou Fan, Shinichiro Omachi

entry.summary: Addresses gradient conflict between pixel-domain and frequency-domain losses in lightweight infrared super-resolution by decomposing the frequency gradient into components parallel and orthogonal to the pixel gradient, keeping only the orthogonal innovation. The plug-and-play optimizer targets unstable multi-loss training on resource-constrained drone platforms.

entry.title: RealDenseFace: Real-time Monocular 3D Face Reconstruction from Dense UV-space Priors

author.name: Linzhou Li, Tianjia Shao, Kun Zhou

entry.summary: Achieves real-time optimization-based monocular 3D face reconstruction by predicting dense correspondence and relative-depth maps in texture space and then solving morphable-model fitting as a nonlinear least-squares problem with a tailored Gauss-Newton solver converging in a few iterations. This cuts per-image fitting from tens of seconds to real time.

entry.title: Alpha as an Efficiency Signal: Visibility-Routed RGBA Image-to-Video Generation

author.name: Zhe Li, Honghao Qiao, Zhixin Xu, Qijie Wang, Bo Peng, Dawei Li

entry.summary: This work generates RGBA (transparency-aware) videos from a single image for game assets, using the alpha channel as a visibility signal to route computation and jointly model color and transparency instead of the usual generate-then-matte pipeline. It also addresses the scarcity of non-photorealistic RGBA training data.

entry.title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras

author.name: Runze Yuan, Alexander Kappler, Jun Zhang, Kuangyi Chen, Fabio Morbidi, Pascal Vasseur, C\'edric Demonceaux, Friedrich Fraundorfer

entry.summary: The paper derives a minimal two-point solver for camera pose from active LED markers observed with event cameras, exploiting gravity direction and altitude available from onboard sensors to reduce point requirements. This eases deployment where structured multi-marker layouts do not fit.

entry.title: Towards Expressive and Faithful Audio-to-Image Generation: A Unified Multimodal Dataset and Synthesis Framework

author.name: Dongxu Ge, Shansong Liu, Cheng Gong, Xiao-Lei Zhang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: The authors release A2I-Set, a tri-modal audio-image-text dataset with higher fidelity and tighter cross-modal alignment than existing corpora, plus a synthesis framework for generating images from audio. The motivation is that audio-to-image quality has been limited by data rather than by text-to-image model capacity.

entry.title: Beyond Hazard Resemblance: Contrastive Event Adjudication for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wenti Yin, Xiang Wang, Huaxin Zhang, Hanqing Wang, Hongbo Shao, Changxin Gao, Nong Sang

entry.summary: CEAVAD makes training-free video anomaly detection work by adjudicating between contrastive, falsifiable event hypotheses instead of scoring similarity to isolated anomaly concepts. The insight is that richer hazard descriptions capture resemblance but do not by themselves define an abnormality decision boundary.

entry.title: Event-Time Hybrid Optimal Control for Robotic Table Tennis Serves

author.name: Thomas Gossard, Till K\"opff, Andreas Ziegler

entry.summary: Formulates robotic table tennis serves as an event-time optimal control problem that jointly optimizes racket impact velocity and orientation along with bounce, net-crossing, and landing times, then converts the result into a kinodynamically feasible arm motion via a second optimization. Hybrid dynamics constraints such as table bounce and net clearance are enforced directly at phase boundaries.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Context-dependent Personalized Movement Compensation in Delayed Telemanipulation

author.name: Sai Jiang, Zonghe Chua

entry.summary: Fits per-participant motion-scaling gains that depend on delay magnitude, movement direction, and distance to counteract overshoot in delayed teleoperation, validated with twenty participants in simulation and on a telesurgical robot. It shows uniform scaling gains ignore substantial individual and contextual variability.

entry.title: Estimation of Spacecraft Inertia Tensor Using Attitude-Only Data from Torque-Free Motion

author.name: Daigo Kobayashi, Vakhtang Putkaradze

entry.summary: Estimates a spacecraft normalized inertia tensor from attitude-only observations of torque-free motion, combining a KKT-based linear initialization with nonlinear shooting using exact Jacobi-elliptic solutions and a Magnus-expansion quaternion map. It requires no gyroscopes or known control torques and outperformed an EKF baseline by roughly an order of magnitude on a single short arc.

entry.title: Real-Time Nonlinear MPC via Sequential Quadratic Programming with Structure-Exploiting ADMM and Interior-Point Methods for Underactuated Double-Pendulum Swing-Up

author.name: Nick Karydakis, Konstantinos Chatzilygeroudis

entry.summary: Reports a real-time nonlinear MPC entry for an underactuated double-pendulum swing-up competition, implemented with sequential quadratic programming and structure-exploiting ADMM and interior-point solvers, and evaluated on remotely accessible hardware without prior model parameters. It shows classical optimal control can reliably swing up and stabilize under tight interaction budgets.

entry.title: A Semantic Communication Approach to Fiducial Marker Processing in 5G-Enabled Edge SLAM

author.name: Boris Radovanovic, Vukan Ninkovic, Katarina Vidojevic, Buda Bajic Papuga, Dejan Vukobratovic

entry.summary: Splits a fiducial-marker detection network between robot and 5G edge server so that intermediate features act as task-oriented semantic information over the wireless link, integrated into a ROS2 edge SLAM architecture. The framework makes marker processing amenable to communication-aware partitioning that conventional pipelines resist.

entry.title: Forking-Sequences — Part II: Multi-Horizon Forecast Ensembling with Reduced Volatility

author.name: Willa Potosnak

entry.summary: The second installment of a CMU machine learning blog series on forking-sequences, a technique for ensembling multi-horizon time-series forecasts to reduce prediction volatility. The retrieved content is essentially empty, so only the topic and venue can be assessed.

entry.title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains

author.name: Hiroki Naito

entry.summary: A conceptual analysis of why human oversight of AI output collapses in high-stakes domains, arguing the binding constraint is output velocity multiplied by per-item cognitive load rather than velocity alone. It decomposes load into triage, judgment, and response, claiming only judgment cost falls with model capability, and often via induced omission rather than genuine reduction.

entry.title: Large Multimodal Agents for Intelligent Transportation Systems: Architectures, Evidence, and Deployment Challenges

author.name: Muhammad Ayub Sabir, Shaohong Zheng, Zhiyu Qu, Fatima Ashraf, Junbiao Pang

entry.summary: A structured literature review that maps 42 study families on large multimodal agents for intelligent transportation systems, separating claims about multimodality, agency, empirical evidence and deployment readiness. It introduces grading scales for capability, validation setting and methodological concerns to expose how thin the real-world evidence base is. Useful as an audit template for hype-heavy application domains.

entry.title: Scale-to-Dialogue: Low-Burden Elicitation of Daily Premenstrual Symptom Ratings with Small Language Models

author.name: Yifan Wang

entry.summary: This work reframes conversational symptom tracking as ordinal label recovery, using a small encoder as an evidence gate plus a 1.5B model to map short dialogues back onto six-level severity ratings for premenstrual symptoms. On a frozen evaluation of 360 participant-days it reduces the burden of repeated ordinal forms while recovering item labels. A small but concrete case for tiny models in clinical data collection.

entry.title: A Multi-Scale Temporal Framework with Dynamic Fusion for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition

author.name: Stefanos Gkikas, Yang Guo, Guangliang Li, Raul Fernandez Rojas, Giorgos Giannakakis, Randy Gomez

entry.summary: Presents an EEG emotion recognition framework that splits the signal into multiple window lengths, encodes them with a shared attention encoder, and combines scales through a sample-specific dynamic fusion module, evaluated subject-independently including a mixed-emotion three-class setting. Targets clinically relevant mixed emotional states that most pipelines ignore.

entry.title: Designing for Ethical AI: HCI Feature Considerations to Improve Fairness and User Experience in AutoML use for Human Resources

author.name: Sundaraparipurnan Narayanan

entry.summary: A thesis analyzing fairness gaps in AutoML platforms used for hiring, arguing that fairness affects usability, trust, and legal compliance, and proposing HCI feature considerations to help non-expert users detect and mitigate bias. Bridges regulation, business strategy, and interface design.

entry.title: From Operational Design Domain to Action: A Systematic Behavioral Taxonomy for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Chaitanya Shinde, Hadi Hajieghrary, Miguel Hurtado

entry.summary: Proposes a standards-grounded taxonomy of 21 behavioral competencies for automated driving systems across highway, urban, and hub domains, derived from the PEGASUS six-layer ODD model. The goal is to close the gap between specifying where a vehicle may operate and validating what it must demonstrably do there.

entry.title: Out-of-Distribution Federated Distillation with Domain-Aware Proxy

author.name: Jiahao Xiao, Jiangming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes domain-aware selection of proxy data for federated distillation so that soft-prediction exchange remains useful under out-of-distribution shift at deployment. Experiments show improved handling of distribution shift compared with distribution-agnostic proxy choice.

entry.title: Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning

author.name: Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha, Gregory Blanc

entry.summary: R2CFL couples a robust reputation model with a nearest-neighbor mixing defense for crowdsourced federated learning, aiming to quantify and improve resilience against stealthy adversaries that evade standard detection. It links reputation evolution to aggregation-level robustness.

entry.title: SoftMCC: An MCC-Brier Calibration Bridge for Threshold-Free Model Selection under Class Imbalance

author.name: \"Ozkan Canay

entry.summary: SoftMCC defines a threshold-free, probability-based analogue of the Matthews correlation coefficient for model selection under class imbalance, which reduces exactly to MCC on hard predictions and equals the Brier skill score under perfect calibration. It comes with a tie-aware shared-pool selection protocol tested across eighteen settings.

entry.title: F2STNet: Fair and Federated Spectral-Temporal Modeling for Graph Forecasting

author.name: Jiayi Zhang, Jinfeng Xu, Hewei Wang, Siyuan Cen, Haidong Huang, Yiyao Zhan, Zheyu Chen, Jinjiang You, Ai Jian, Edith C. H. Ngai

entry.summary: F2STNet combines truncated graph-Fourier features, a diagonal state-space temporal encoder and graph convolution for federated spatiotemporal forecasting, with an aggregation rule that reweights clients using validation losses under an increasing fairness schedule. Evaluated on traffic and air-quality datasets.

entry.title: FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations

author.name: Satwat Bashir, Tasos Dagiuklas, Muddesar Iqbal

entry.summary: Proposes FedOrbit, a personalized federated learning scheme for satellite constellations where orbital geometry drives both data skew and intermittent connectivity. It mixes orbit-level training over inter-satellite links with class-aware hierarchical aggregation and adaptive feature decomposition, reporting best accuracy in five of six benchmark settings.

entry.title: Can Webcam Gaze Constrain Mesa-Objectives in Driving Models? An Instrument Precision Analysis

author.name: Lennox Anderson, Ahmed Boutar, Jonah Mulcrone, Tal Erez

entry.summary: Tests whether webcam-based eye tracking can supply privileged human attention signals to constrain spurious internal objectives in driving hazard detection models, using over 137,000 gaze samples across nearly 400 dashcam clips. Across two calibration protocols, two architectures, and five seeds, no experiment yielded a significant benefit, and the paper is framed as an instrument precision analysis.

entry.title: XFeat Revisited: Reproducibility and Evaluation of a Lightweight Image Matcher

author.name: Lazar {\DJ}okovi\'c, Aimee Lin

entry.summary: A reproducibility study of a lightweight local feature extractor and matcher, distinguishing re-evaluation of released checkpoints from full re-implementation and documenting discrepancies among the paper, supplement, and public code. Adds ablations on backbone, fusion block, and loss choices that the original work left unjustified.

entry.title: C$^2$A: Coupling Spatial Evidence with Clinical Priors via Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification

author.name: Akash Gogineni, Nagur Shareef Shaik, Aasrith Mandava, Adnan Masood, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: Introduces a chest X-ray classification head that pools features as an expectation over per-class spatial attention maps and then propagates evidence across a learnable label graph initialized from empirical disease co-occurrence. Aims to keep both the spatial location of findings and clinical co-occurrence structure that global pooling discards.

entry.title: Comparing British and American Audio Description of Movies

author.name: Igor Sterner, Alex Lascarides, Frank Keller

entry.summary: A corpus comparison of British versus American movie audio description, testing hypotheses drawn from regional guidelines and practitioner interviews. The findings document systematic cross-regional stylistic differences in how visual content is narrated.

entry.title: PARAGraph: Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading

author.name: Ziyang Zhang, Yuankai Huo, Yalin Zheng, He Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a three-level hierarchical graph representation for diabetic retinopathy grading that encodes lesion nodes, category/region nodes and global anatomical nodes within an optic-disc/fovea anchored coordinate system. The goal is to make grading decisions rest on clinically grounded lesion evidence rather than opaque image-level classification.

entry.title: RenderMatte: Exact-Alpha Rendering and Group-Relative Alignment for Image Matting

author.name: Zecheng Ren, Yafei Hu, Jianing Zhao, Ruichen Cong, Qun Jin, Yiren Song

entry.summary: Adapts a large image-editing diffusion backbone through full fine-tuning for trimap-guided image matting, adding exact-alpha rendering and a group-relative preference alignment stage to sharpen opacity estimation in fragile boundary regions. It targets open-world foregrounds where semantic ambiguity breaks existing matting models.

entry.title: SC-Diff: Semantically Calibrated Diffusion for Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation

author.name: Junyin Zhang, Siyu Huang, Jianxiong Ye, Haowei Gong, Ruicheng Zhang, Deyu Meng, Chenqiang Gao

entry.summary: Generates synthetic infrared imagery from visible images with a latent diffusion model that injects semantic priors both as external conditioning and as an internal calibration of self-attention, using a promptable segmentation foundation model for the priors. The purpose is to expand scarce infrared training data while keeping annotations reusable.

entry.title: Parcel2Progression: An Anatomy-aware Longitudinal Framework for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis

author.name: Madhumitha Venkatesh, Shanawaj S Madarkar, Konda Reddy Mopuri

entry.summary: A longitudinal transformer for Alzheimer's diagnosis that tokenizes full-resolution structural brain MRI into anatomically defined parcels and then integrates irregular, variable-length visit sequences alongside patient age. This avoids the usual trade-off between spatial detail and number of longitudinal scans.

entry.title: LASA: Language-and-Source-Anchored Alignment for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Jinhong Zhu, Weiqi Yan, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: For domain-generalized semantic segmentation, this work argues style randomization distorts the feature manifold and normalization erases discriminative domain-sensitive detail, and instead anchors alignment jointly to language embeddings and the source domain. Three coupled components handle guided style transfer and alignment.

entry.title: SI-Edit: Toward Sketch-Instruction Guided Local Image Editing with Pixel-Level Precision

author.name: Weixin Ye, Wei Wang, Hongguang Zhu, Xuecheng Nie

entry.summary: Releases a dataset of image, local sketch, instruction, and edited-image quadruplets synthesized through a multimodal-language-model pipeline, then trains a model for sketch-plus-instruction local editing with pixel-level precision. It targets fine-grained geometric deformations that text alone cannot specify.

entry.title: RAGMesh with FaME-G2E: Long-Form Text-Driven 3D Face Generation and Editing

author.name: Hao Li, Ju Dai, Feng Zhou, Mengting Shi, Haofei Wang, Zhen Song, Wei Zhou, Lei Li, Junjun Pan

entry.summary: Contributes a large multimodal dataset pairing detailed text with 3D face meshes and blendshapes, and a retrieval-augmented framework that turns long-form descriptions into fine-grained facial geometry and edits. It focuses on subtle local deformations such as eyebrow tension and asymmetric mouth motion that global alignment misses.

entry.title: Warp-free Cross-view Geo-localization via Feature-space Consensus Mining

author.name: Zhuo Song, Lian Xu, Runqing Jiang, Yongjian Zhang, Kunhong Li, Ye Zhang, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: Removes explicit geometric warping from cross-view street-to-satellite geo-localization, arguing that warping relies on restrictive spatial assumptions and injects severe distortion. Instead the method mines and strengthens semantic consensus directly in feature space through an auxiliary joint-view branch.

entry.title: Revisiting the Current Frame: Physical-Trace-Guided Network Output Correction for Video Restoration

author.name: Yifeng Lin, Liuxiang Qiu, Guangming Ren, Tiesong Zhao

entry.summary: ANCHOR is a model-agnostic post-processing framework for video restoration that treats the degraded current frame as a temporally aligned reference and estimates a per-pixel trust field to decide where network outputs should be corrected. It targets a mostly unexamined issue: spatially varying reliability of restored outputs when reference frames introduce occlusion or aggregation errors.

entry.title: Preserve More Details: Mitigating Content Drift in Real-World Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Chunxiao Liu, Wei Liu, Anbin Xiong, Erli Meng

entry.summary: FSP-Diff is a one-step diffusion model for real-world image super-resolution with a dual-pathway design that separates detail conditioning from semantic guidance to reduce content drift, where generated details or text semantics deviate from the low-quality input. The focus is preserving fidelity while keeping single-step efficiency.

entry.title: Identifying potentiating events in evolutionary search using replay experiments

author.name: Austin J. Ferguson, Alexander Lalejini

entry.summary: This paper imports replay experiments from experimental evolutionary biology into evolutionary computation, restarting runs from different historical checkpoints to identify potentiating events that made a later outcome likely. It provides a step-by-step design guide plus demonstrations of the analysis.

entry.title: TAMS: Task-Aware Multi-View Adaptive Streaming for Wireless Telerobotic Manipulation

author.name: Zexin Deng, Zhenhui Yuan, Lu Tian, Subhash Lakshminarayana, Longhao Zou

entry.summary: TAMS allocates limited uplink bitrate across multiple teleoperation camera views according to the inferred manipulation phase, prioritizing the currently relevant view while keeping baseline visibility elsewhere. On a six-DOF teleoperation testbed under constrained networks it improved primary-view image quality, task time, and success rate over equal and static allocation.

entry.title: Exact Contraction Rates via the Berkson--Porta Representation: A Sharp Threshold and Its Herglotz-Kernel Obstruction

author.name: Soumic Sarkar

entry.summary: Uses the Berkson-Porta representation of holomorphic semigroups on the unit disc to determine exactly when a flow contracts the Kobayashi metric at the optimal linearization rate rather than a conservative one, reducing the question to a single pointwise inequality. The inequality is fully resolved for a natural one-parameter family and an obstruction is identified via Herglotz kernels.

entry.title: Parameter-Dependent LMI Synthesis for Semi-Global Differential ISS Trajectory Tracking of Nonholonomic Mobile Robots Under Multiplicative Wheel Slip

author.name: Mohammad Sabouri

entry.summary: Develops a parameter-dependent LMI synthesis for trajectory tracking of nonholonomic mobile robots under severe multiplicative wheel slip, certifying semi-global differential input-to-state stability, prescribed decay rate, pole placement, and bounded gains simultaneously. A key contribution is an explicit bound translating multiplicative slip into an additive disturbance in Kanayama error coordinates.

entry.title: Trajectory-Induced Self-Calibration for Hidden-Target Localization Through an Unknown-Pose Range-Bearing Relay

author.name: Yash Bagla

entry.summary: Characterizes the minimal vehicle motion needed to localize a hidden target when the only information comes from a relay beacon of unknown position and yaw reporting local-frame range and bearing to both vehicle and target. One pose leaves a continuous gauge ambiguity while two distinct relative observations resolve it.

entry.title: Conditionally Resampled Sliding-Window Count Kernels: Spectral-Gap Bounds and Poincar\'e Inequalities

author.name: Yanjin Xiang, Yuchen Xin, Zhihua Zhang

entry.summary: Establishes a Poincare inequality and an explicit spectral-gap lower bound scaling inversely with window length for the conditionally resampled sliding-window count kernel derived from a reversible finite-state Markov chain. The proof combines a martingale oscillation inequality for the path law with a direct argument.

entry.title: Is it ethical to work on general-purpose robots given the risk of totalitarianism?

author.name: Master Chief

entry.summary: A question post asking whether it is ethical to work on general-purpose robots that can learn physical tasks and manufacture copies of themselves, given that such capabilities could drastically lower the cost of enforcing a totalitarian regime. The author notes a gap in existing literature, which covers autonomous weapons but not general robotics as a coercion-enablement pathway.

entry.title: Evidence-Calibrated Runtime Reconstruction for Agent Skills Across Heterogeneous Coding Agents

author.name: Xueping Gao

entry.summary: Describes a passive runtime observability system that reconstructs the lifecycle stages of reusable agent skill packages across heterogeneous coding agent harnesses, explicitly marking unsupported stages as unknown. Separates immutable events, deterministic relations, inferred diagnoses, and verified outcomes with graded evidence levels, and supports standard trace import and export.

entry.title: Universal or Language-Family-Specific Script Unification for Cross-Lingual Transfer? A Case Study on Turkic Languages

author.name: Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Compares a general-purpose romanizer against a language-family-specific common script for unifying writing systems across eleven Turkic languages, training matched embedding models and evaluating on named entity recognition and part-of-speech tagging. Finds no significant difference on NER with both beating monolingual baselines, and no universal winner for tagging, with outcomes tracking cross-lingual character n-gram coverage.

entry.title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions

author.name: Jianlin Ye, Christos Kyrkou

entry.summary: A survey of vision-based vehicle detection for UAV traffic monitoring that reviews recent deep learning approaches and adds experimental comparisons on accuracy and latency. It highlights deployment issues such as altitude variation, motion-induced distortion, and high-resolution processing cost.

entry.title: IRPol-Fuse: Energy-structure coordination for infrared polarization fusion under low visibility

author.name: Zhuangfan Huang, Chusheng Fang, Xiaosong Li, Yang Liua, Xiaoqi Cheng, Haishu Tan

entry.summary: IRPol-Fuse fuses infrared and polarization imagery for low-visibility perception, using attention-based allocation plus separate injectors that preserve infrared highlights and weak polarization textures. It targets the tendency of prior fusion methods to suppress faint but informative polarization detail in dark regions.

entry.title: CUPA-T2*: Covariance-Aware Uncertainty Propagation and Alignment for T2* Mapping in Accelerated MRI

author.name: Gideon N. L. Rouwendaal, Natascha Niessen, Hannah Eichhorn, Dirk H. J. Poot, Christine Preibisch, Julia A. Schnabel

entry.summary: Propagates voxel-wise uncertainty from Monte-Carlo-dropout accelerated MRI reconstructions into downstream quantitative T2-star parameter fitting using covariance-aware sampling and a heteroscedastic network with a variance-alignment regularizer. The goal is trustworthy quantitative biomarkers from undersampled scans.

entry.title: MPPI Planning with Gaussian Based Human Cost Function for Social Navigation

author.name: Chinmay Mundane

entry.summary: Adds predictive Gaussian interaction fields to MPPI social navigation, propagating pedestrian predictions across the planning horizon as anisotropic repulsive fields whose forward spread grows with walking speed. This replaces the common practice of treating people as static point obstacles at their current positions.

entry.title: Anchor-Based AI Approach for Pre-Crash Object Detection Utilizing Micro-Doppler Signatures in Automotive Radar

author.name: Patrick Zaumseil, Rainer Engert, Dagmar Steinhauser, Jonathan Wache, Soumya Dewangan, Thomas Brandmeier

entry.summary: Applies an anchor-based detector to automotive radar micro-Doppler signatures for pre-crash object detection and kinematic parameter estimation, aimed at reliably triggering irreversible restraint systems such as smart airbags. High-resolution radar features are shown to sharpen classification and state estimates in the moments before impact.

entry.title: Task-Oriented Formation Decision via Reinforcement Learning: Herding an Attacking Swarm

author.name: Zhaozong Wang, Guibin Sun, Jinyong Chen, Rui Zhou

entry.summary: Formulates multi-robot herding of a faster attacking swarm as a reinforcement learning problem over a low-dimensional parametric encoding of formation shape, so defenders optimize continuous formation parameters rather than selecting from predefined shapes. This addresses attackers with superior maneuverability and unknown strategies.

entry.title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets

author.name: Ximeng Liu, Qianlong Wang, Yingming Mao, Annan Li, Yatao Li, Shizhen Zhao, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware ...

entry.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification

author.name: Kai Cheng, Ruoqi Wang, Qiong Luo

entry.summary: The paper adds post-hoc uncertainty estimation to deep foundation models used for galaxy morphology classification, separating sources of uncertainty arising from noisy instruments and genuinely ambiguous evolving morphologies. Current astronomical classifiers are deterministic point estimators, so calibrated uncertainty improves scientific usability. It is a domain application of established uncertainty quantification ideas.

entry.title: Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models

author.name: Abdalla Doleh, Toni Somers, Ratna Babu Chinnam

entry.summary: The authors automate generation of decision-making scenarios with controlled cognitive complexity, validating over 4,000 generated scenarios against task-complexity theory with psychometric criteria and near-perfect agreement across five model families. This replaces slow, inconsistent manual scenario writing for behavioral research. It is an example of LLMs as instrument-construction tools for social science.

entry.title: Findings of the First Teaching Monster Challenge: A Benchmark of Pedagogical Content Knowledge in AI Agents

author.name: Yi-Cheng Lin, Yu-Kai Guo, Szu-Chi Chen, Bo-Han Feng, Yun-Man Hsu, Hsiang Hsieh, Yu-Jung Lin, Yue-Ling Wu, Jia-Kai Dong, An-Yu Cheng, Yu-Han Huang, Lok-Lam Ieong, Kuan-Yu Chen, Ming-Douo Tchouang, Shao-Hua Sun, Che Lin, Jian-Jiun Ding, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents can now solve problems, answer like subject experts, and generate long-form multimodal content. However, whether they can adapt a lesson to f...

entry.title: Depth-Aware Implicit Neural Representation Priors for 3D Gravity Inversion

author.name: Le\'on Suarez-Rodriguez, Paul Goyes-Pe\~nafiel, Javier Torres-Quintero, Henry Arguello

entry.summary: An unsupervised approach to three-dimensional gravity inversion that represents the subsurface density field with multiple coordinate-based neural networks assigned to overlapping depth slabs, providing a depth-aware implicit prior without paired training data. This addresses the ill-posedness and depth attenuation that plague classical regularized inversion. A clean application of implicit neural representations to geophysical imaging.

entry.title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models

author.name: Xuanchen Li, Haitao Li, Yujia Zhou, Qingyi Pan, Heng Wang, Yiqun Liu, Min Zhang, Qingyao Ai

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different sc...

entry.title: MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation

author.name: Ruiyu Li, Haoyang Cai, Zhitong Guo, Tong Hu

entry.summary: MELLON adds multimodal enhancements to web navigation agents on the WebShop benchmark, including a visual question answering helper agent and a multimodal reranker, reporting a roughly nine point accuracy gain after one epoch of training. Explores text-image alignment for shopping-style web tasks.

entry.title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents

author.name: Tianjun Pan, Yuan Li, Hongda Wang, Linbo Jin, Mengfei Song, Lei Gao, Qiming Shi, Shaokang Fu, Jiarong Zhao, Chengyu Wang, Chengfu Huo

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: External natural-language skills provide large language model (LLM) agents with reusable and editable guidance for solving complex tasks. Yet their eff...

entry.title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems

author.name: Aimilios Hadjiliasi, Louis Nisiotis

entry.summary: Proposes CEAA, a modular cognitive architecture for embodied intelligent virtual agents in real-time interactive environments, combining the sense-think-act paradigm with belief-desire-intention style reasoning to bridge low-level engine-bound control and high-level reasoning models. Targets deployability in commercial game engines.

entry.title: How to Ask the AI: A User Perspective Survey for Large Language Model Prompting

author.name: Yiqun Zhang, Yunfan Zhang, Mingjie Zhao, Sen Feng, Yiu-ming Cheung

entry.summary: A survey of prompting from the end-user perspective, organizing principles and taxonomies for how non-expert users can structure effective requests to LLMs. Positions prompt construction as a systematic skill rather than casual typing.

entry.title: DA-NBV: A Direction-Aware Next-Best-View Planner for Efficient 3D Reconstruction of Ships at Sea

author.name: Jiaming Chen, Juntao Yang, Zhentao Zou, Qi Ming, Yi Yu, Zhihang Zhong, Xue Yang, Xue Jiang, Yue Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a direction-aware next-best-view planner that adds directional observation history to occupancy modelling so a robot or drone can efficiently reconstruct ships at sea despite heavy self-occlusion. Targets maritime supervision and damage assessment where manual capture trajectories are costly.

entry.title: CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling

author.name: Zheyang Jing, Qin Lu, Jianwang Li, Yujie Yang, Chen Yi, Shaofeng Jiang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often mo...

entry.title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review

author.name: Ming Li, Chenguang Wang, Xirui Li, Xinyue Zeng, Dianqi Li, Peng Shi, Dawei Zhou, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices...

entry.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Santosh Nukavarapu, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Examines whether transparent prescription contact lenses degrade iris recognition and proposes a two-stage mask-guided attention detector for them. Shows with a commercial matcher that clear lenses do measurably raise verification error, contradicting the common assumption of no effect.

entry.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents

author.name: Xin Zhou, Chun Yong Chong, Kisub Kim, Yun Peng, Rui Shu, Zihan Wu, Xu Han, Guowen Yuan, Zeyang Zhuang, Jounghoon Kim, Jeongjin Ju, Seongmin Ju, Taein Yoon, David Lo

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09072v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs...

entry.title: FedA2L: Adaptive layer-wise learning rate adjustment in decentralized federated learning

author.name: Van Truong Vo, Khoa Nguyen, Taehong Kim

entry.summary: FedA2L adapts per-layer learning rates in decentralized federated learning using model divergence signals, on the premise that early layers must maintain consensus while later layers specialize to local data. Aims to fix slow convergence under non-IID client distributions.

entry.title: Deep Learning based Detection of Fishing Vessels and Fishing Monitoring using Nightlight Images

author.name: Shantakar Mohanty, Prasun Kumar Gupta, Raian Vargas Maretto

entry.summary: Detects small dark fishing vessels that do not broadcast AIS using nighttime-light satellite imagery from SDGSAT-1 with a dual-branch YOLO11 model that fuses 10-meter panchromatic and 40-meter RGB bands. Applied to maritime monitoring along India's west coast.

entry.title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation

author.name: Zian Li, Litong Gong, Borui Liao, Pengfei Liu, Xinyu Wang, Xinyuan Wei, Yifan Gao, Tiezheng Ge, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09637v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployme...

entry.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness

author.name: Pinzhen Chen, Koel Dutta Chowdhury, Xiaoya Xu, David Tan, Doreen Osmelak, Ona de Gibert, Ariun-Erdene Tumurchuluun, Ashok Urlana, Fedor Sizov, Hale Sirin, Jesujoba Alabi, Karrar Talib Abed, Mateusz Klimaszewski, Nikolay Bogoychev, Niyati Bafna, Patricia Schmidtova, Preksha Manjunath Shanbhag, Sherrie Shen, Vilem Zouhar, Vivek Iyer, Yasser Hamidullah, Yusser Al Ghussin, Zheng Zhao

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09766v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of eval...

entry.title: Unimodality-Promoting Regularized Learning for Ordinal Regression

author.name: Ryoya Yamasaki

entry.summary: Analyzes regularized learning that pushes predicted conditional class distributions toward unimodal shapes in ordinal regression, arguing this reduces prediction variance without much bias when the data really is close to unimodal. Provides a formal treatment of when the unimodality prior helps.

entry.title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Xiang Xie

entry.summary: MGMCL reformulates cross-subject EEG emotion recognition as continuous representation learning on symmetric positive definite Riemannian manifolds, adding contrastive objectives at instance, emotion and trajectory levels. Manifold neural ODEs model emotional dynamics as continuous trajectories rather than discrete labels.

entry.title: Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection

author.name: Mihailo Ili\'c, Milo\v{s} Savi\'c, Vladimir Kurbalija, Mirjana Ivanovi\'c, Giancarlo Fortino, Du\v{s}an Jakoveti\'c

entry.summary: Proposes two aggregation functions designed for attention-based autoencoders in federated anomaly detection, arguing that standard averaging destroys information stored in attention memory modules. Evaluates the resulting federated outlier detectors on decentralized data.

entry.title: Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance

author.name: Logan Luna (Georgia Institute of Technology), Juan Ortiz Couder (Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University), Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta (Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University)

entry.summary: Trains a proximal policy optimization agent for autonomous satellite collision avoidance using an open-source high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator, motivated by rising conjunction alerts from megaconstellations. Positions learned policies as more scalable than current manual or rule-based practices.

entry.title: PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Mona Furukawa, Sai Hyne, Daniel R. McGowan, Bart{\l}omiej W. Papie\.z

entry.summary: Uses deep learning on PET/CT imaging to predict EGFR, TP53, and KRAS mutation status in non-small cell lung cancer, aiming to reduce reliance on invasive biopsy. It tests whether pairwise multi-label training beats single-gene classifiers.

entry.title: Crowd-Sourced Geographies of Income: Using Google Maps Points of Interest as High-Frequency Proxies for Sub-Municipal Income Estimation in Sao Paulo, Brazil

author.name: Adrienne C. Kinney, Anya Workman, Ademar Takeo Akabane, Jenna Barac, Paulo Fernando Braga Carvalho, Jeova Farias, Fernando Nascimento, Paulo Ricardo da Silva Oliveira

entry.summary: Tests whether the mix of crowd-sourced Google Maps points of interest can proxy household income across more than 26,000 census sectors in Sao Paulo, filling gaps between costly decennial censuses. Sparse POI count features are compressed with PCA and NMF and fed to a sweep of regression models.

entry.title: NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage

author.name: Taigo Sakai, Kazuhito Hotta

entry.summary: NeuroGuard controls how strongly the feature representation is updated at each task boundary in long-tailed class-incremental learning, rather than modifying replay, classifiers, or losses. Adaptive gradient scaling from teacher uncertainty and confidence-ranked distillation reweighting are added to an existing replay baseline without new parameters.

entry.title: Learning under Opponent Unawareness in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Games

author.name: Dantong Chu, Xuefeng Gao, Yufei Zhang

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As firms increasingly deploy machine learning for strategic decision-making, understanding algorithmic interactions has become central to operations ...

entry.title: Sparse Attention to Emotion: Efficient Facial Emotion Recognition via Token Reduction

author.name: Aya Manel Zitouni, Aicha Zenakhri, Karim Haroun, Larbi Boubchir

entry.summary: Argues that facial emotion recognition needs only discriminative regions such as eyes, mouth, and cheeks, and therefore discards uninformative image tokens to cut the quadratic cost of vision transformers. The goal is edge-deployable emotion recognition.

entry.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance

author.name: Dongchi Huang, Hongyin Zhang, Bohan Hou, Siteng Huang, Zhian Su, Hang Guo, Tong Lu, Zhaofeng Xu, Jiahao Tang, Jianfei Yang, Donglin Wang, Peixi Peng, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao, Xin Li

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09853v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from...

entry.title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages

author.name: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka

entry.summary: Trains five small GPT-2 scale models from scratch to compare four dedicated monolingual Dravidian language models against one joint multilingual model with a shared larger vocabulary, evaluating perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning transfer. Provides controlled evidence on the monolingual versus multilingual tradeoff for underrepresented languages.

entry.title: APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain

author.name: Marie Escribe, Tharindu Ranasinghe, Amal Haddad Haddad, Hansi Hettiarachchi, Damith Premasiri

entry.summary: Releases a document-level English-Spanish automatic post-editing corpus built from recent healthcare virtual-ward documents with professional post-editing in a real translation tool and controlled machine translation and terminology settings. Designed to study how corrections propagate across segments, which sentence-level corpora cannot capture.

entry.title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs

author.name: Rama Alomair, Remas Alsubaie, Walaa Saifalislam, Rima Alsonbul, Mona Alnajjar, Razan Aldossari, Haya Alibrahim, Abeer Aldayel

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clea...

entry.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents

author.name: Zihao Deng, Yining Zhu, Leiming Wang, Jingfei Lu, Junbo Wang, Chuncheng Ran, Yu Yang, Dixuan Yang, Jikun Shen

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically ...

entry.title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities

author.name: Avijit Roy, Proma Roy, Hrishitva Patel

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure do...

entry.title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification

author.name: Abner Hernandez, Tom\'as Arias Vergara, Daiqi Liu, Andreas Maier, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro

entry.summary: This study tests whether representations from a phonological-feature model help classify articulatory patterns captured by real-time vocal-tract MRI paired with audio. It compares self-supervised speech baselines against models augmented with structured phonological features under unseen-speech and unseen-speaker conditions.

entry.title: Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI

author.name: Mengqi Shen, Haicheng Wang, Meghna Trivedi, Tony J. Wang, Yuanguang Xu, Yingyan Zeng, Yading Yuan

entry.summary: Presents a cross-contrast super-resolution pipeline that uses high-resolution T1-contrast MRI to restore through-plane resolution of anisotropic T2-weighted brain scans without needing isotropic ground truth. A view-independent patch generator learns local anatomical correspondence and is then applied across orthogonal views.

entry.title: EvTrajGS: Accurate and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unposed Event Streams

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Jiakai Zhang, Junhao Dong, Guangcong Wang, Jianhuang Lai, Yew-Soon Ong, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.08585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event cameras, with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and asynchronous sensing characteristics, have shown great potential for dense 3D rec...

entry.title: Visual Token Codec: Unleashing Spatial Redundancy for ViT Feature Coding

author.name: Donghui Feng, Fengxi Zhang, Changsheng Gao, Wenhan Yang, Qi Wang, Qunshan Gu, Hongwei Hu, Zhengxue Cheng, Li Song

entry.summary: Handles 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction when input photos have heterogeneous JPEG compression quality, using each file's stored quantization tables to build a view-specific compression operator so rendered views are compared in a matched domain. This prevents blocking and ringing artifacts from corrupting shared Gaussians.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Traffic Accident Detection via a Coarse-to-Fine VLM-Tracking Pipeline

author.name: Dipit Saha, Shah Mohammad Abdul Mannan, Mohammad Raihan Rashid, Ruwad Naswan, Ahnaf Tahmid

entry.summary: A completely training-free pipeline for detecting and characterizing traffic accidents in CCTV video, combining a frozen open-weight vision-language model with an object detector and tracker in a coarse-then-fine two-pass temporal localization strategy. It targets a benchmark that forbids labeled real-world training data.

entry.title: AeroReformer2: Spoken-Query Referring Segmentation for Aerial Images

author.name: Rui Li, Chenxi Duan, Haoyang Yang

entry.summary: Introduces a spoken-query benchmark for referring segmentation in aerial and remote-sensing imagery, adding accent- and voice-diverse speech plus rotor, wind, and mixed noise at several signal-to-noise levels, together with an efficient bilateral audio-visual segmentation network. The motivation is hands-free target specification for drone operators.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Model for Hysteroscopic Surgical Scene Segmentation

author.name: Jun Huang, Meiyi Chen, Zijie Yue, Yuhang Xiao, Fang Li, Hanli Wang, Xiaowen Tong, Yi Guo, Miaojing Shi

entry.summary: Presents what the authors describe as the first vision-language-model-based segmentation method for hysteroscopic surgical scenes, covering fifteen categories despite high morphological similarity among lesions and artifacts such as specular reflection, blur, and fluid occlusion. It pairs a pretrained image encoder with language-guided decoding.

entry.title: Degraded Infrared Small Object Detection via Degradation-Adapted Physics-Guided Restoration

author.name: Xinkai Lu, Wenjun Chen, Yi Li, Yi Chang, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Builds an infrared small-object detector that first classifies degradation type and severity such as fog or sensor nonuniformity, routes to dedicated physics-guided restoration branches, and fuses the results before detection. It aims to generalize across degradation types rather than assuming one.

entry.title: Efficient Human-Contact Representation for Human-Scene Interaction

author.name: Nghia Vu, Tuong Do, Binh X. Nguyen, Erman Tjiputra, Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: The authors introduce sparse contact masks as a compact representation of where a human body touches its environment, then build spatial models on top for human-scene interaction tasks. The claim is large reductions in redundant high-dimensional contact input while keeping accuracy.

entry.title: CoInS-Net: A Continuous Position-Aware Network for Joint Medical Image Interpolation and Segmentation

author.name: Yujia Sun, Ningfeng Que, Peiting Shi, Rongrong Fu, Yingying Yang, Xinhang Li, Yin Dai

entry.summary: CoInS-Net jointly performs through-plane interpolation and lesion segmentation on anisotropic medical volumes using a continuous position-aware design, instead of running interpolation and segmentation as separate cascaded stages. The goal is to exploit complementary cross-slice structure and avoid redundant computation.

entry.title: DocPure: Prompt-Free Unified Document Restoration via Degradation-Aware Structure-Guided Wavelet Modulation

author.name: Lingming Su (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Wanglong Lu (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China, AI Analytics Team, Nasdaq, St. John's, Canada), Tao Wang (vivo Mobile Communication Co., Ltd, Shanghai, China), Kaihao Zhang (College of Engineering and Computer Science, The Australian National University, Canberra, Australia), Nan Zhang (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Liyan An (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China), Hanli Zhao (College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou, China)

entry.summary: DocPure is a prompt-free unified document restoration model that predicts clean structural priors with a degradation-aware autoencoder and uses wavelet-domain modulation to handle multiple degradation types in one network. It avoids per-degradation models, manual task prompts and paired cross-task data.

entry.title: Towards Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction: Framework, Baseline Evaluation, and Deployment Perspectives

author.name: Lei Wan, Hannan Ejaz Keen, Alexey Vinel

entry.summary: This work outlines a conceptual framework and baseline evaluation for collaborative joint perception and prediction among connected vehicles, unifying V2X-shared perception with motion forecasting to reduce error accumulation and occlusion effects. It also discusses deployment considerations such as communication constraints.

entry.title: PressureMesh: 3D Human Mesh Estimation from Multi-Device Pressure Images

author.name: Changhai Ma, Ziyu Wu, Yunkang Zhang, Fangting Xie, Mengting Niu, Heyu Ding, Quan Wan, Jiayue Yuan, Boyan Liu, Yi Ke, Xiaohui Cai

entry.summary: PressureMesh (MDP-Net) reconstructs 3D human body meshes from temporal pressure-sensor images spanning multiple devices, using a mixture-of-experts style fusion to combine cross-device signals. It extends privacy-preserving pressure-based pose monitoring beyond single-mat coverage limits.

entry.title: VideoVIBE: A Video-Grounded Diagnostic Benchmark for One-Shot Interactive Website Generation

author.name: Jiajun Xu, Yanghao Zhou, Jingyun Liao, Yu Bai, Jinxing Zhou, Chengliang Liu, Changsen Yuan, Bo Wang, Qian Liu

entry.summary: arXiv:2608.09573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Natural-language-driven "vibe coding" enables the one-shot generation of visually rich and interactive web applications, yet reliable assessment of the...

entry.title: TeaMatch: Teachable Cross-Modal Representation Learning for 2D-3D Matching

author.name: Chongjian Wang, Junjie Gao

entry.summary: TeaMatch introduces teachability, defined as how well a representation can be recovered by weak student learners under degraded inputs, as a training criterion for image-to-point-cloud matching. The claim is that representations that survive weak-learner recovery are structurally more robust to noise, low overlap and ambiguous geometry.

entry.title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization

author.name: Yifei Cao, Guolong Wang, Mingliang Hou, Xiya Bu, Daming Liu, Yu Liu
